g.text: Rectangles = breakout regions · circles = component pads · filled boundary points = solver-selected gates
Dashed paths are straight-line guides, not copper traces · outer dots marked “target” are destinations when present
Each color follows one connection through its boundary gates
Gray = geometry shared by multiple layers

text.data-label: Valid: one bus-constrained breakout point per connection and region; pairs are adjacent
